arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS epilepsy_patients_received_levetiracetam
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor epilepsy_ca
  ON co.condition_concept_id = epilepsy_ca.descendant_concept_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de
  ON co.person_id = de.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor lev_ca
  ON de.drug_concept_id = lev_ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE epilepsy_ca.ancestor_concept_id = 380378
  AND lev_ca.ancestor_concept_id = 711584;

content.text:
I picked **levetiracetam**, a common antiseizure medicine.

Among patients with an **epilepsy** condition concept or descendant, **16,182 distinct epilepsy patients** received levetiracetam or a descendant drug exposure.
